question: Will a named hurricane form in the Atlantic Ocean before Nov 30, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the National Hurricane Center (NHC) officially names at least one Atlantic tropical or subtropical cyclone that reaches named-storm status (maximum sustained winds ≥ 39 mph / 34 kt) strictly after 2026-09-30T15:51:42.565Z and at or before 2026-11-30T05:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if the NHC does not officially name any Atlantic tropical or subtropical cyclone in the window strictly after 2026-09-30T15:51:42.565Z and at or before 2026-11-30T05:00:00.000Z.

Clarifications:
- "Named hurricane" is interpreted as any NHC-named Atlantic tropical or subtropical storm (i.e., any system that receives an official name from the NHC's Atlantic name list), including tropical storms and hurricanes; a storm that was already named before the window opens does not qualify unless a new, distinct named storm is designated within the window.
